svg.text: Integration platform (phase 1) and Intelligence domain (phase 2) · demo of the Nordic APIs Summit 2026 talk “AI as a new architectural domain”
GitHub · azure-intelligence-domain organisation · one repository per ownership boundary
GitHub Actions per repository → reusable contract check (adidas API guidelines: lint, version, no breaking changes): no contract, no deploy → OIDC login, no stored secrets
Released contracts (asyncapi.yaml / openapi.yaml, topic eventcatalog) → EventCatalog, rebuilt daily, on GitHub Pages and Azure Storage · every deploy → deployment event in the tap
Azure subscription · pay-as-you-go · consumption tiers only · €10/month cap
Event Intake API · Event Grid only
API-led building blocks · one repository, resource group and identity each
push to consumers via the intake
the platform, nobody can opt out
OIDC: each repository deploys its own resource group
Icons: Microsoft Azure Architecture Icons V24. Generated by docs/architecture/solution_design.py · regions verified 2026-10-16, step 6 2026-10-17.
